title: Managed Content Version
description: Represents a published version of managed CMS content delivered through Experience Cloud channels.

managedContentId.description: Salesforce record ID of the managed content item

contentKey.description: Unique content key used for content retrieval and referencing

contentUrlName.description: URL-friendly name for the content, used in page URLs

title.description: Display title of the content item

type.description: Developer name of the content type (e.g., news, cms_image, cms_document)

typeLabel.description: Human-readable label for the content type

language.description: Language code of this content version (e.g., en_US)

publishedDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this content version was published

status.description: Current publication status of the content

contentNodes.description: Content field values organized as typed nodes, keyed by field name

unauthenticatedUrl.description: Public URL for accessing this content without authentication

ContentNode.description: A typed content node representing a field value within managed content

nodeType.description: Type of the content node determining how the value should be interpreted

value.description: Text or scalar value of the node

url.description: URL value for Media and Url node types

altText.description: Alternative text for accessibility (Media node type)

fileName.description: Original file name for media content

mediaType.description: Classification of media content (e.g., Image, Document, Video)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the content (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

contentKey.description: Content key for referenced content items

unauthenticatedUrl.description: Public URL for unauthenticated access to the content
